name: saas-aviation
description: Next-generation multi-tenant aviation SaaS ERP for AeroCanada / Yoyamic.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @saas-aviation/shared && npm run build -w @saas-aviation/api && npm run build -w @saas-aviation/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @saas-aviation/web && npm run lint -w @saas-aviation/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @saas-aviation/shared && npm run build -w @saas-aviation/shared && npm run typecheck -w @saas-aviation/api && npm run typecheck -w @saas-aviation/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @saas-aviation/shared && npm run build -w @saas-aviation/shared && npm run test -w @saas-aviation/api && npm run test -w @saas-aviation/web
